title: CatNFish
author: smhaaker
desc_full: Move with arrow keys Navigate the rooms Find the fish Exit through the yellow exterior wall in the randomly generated exit room Dont get caught I wanted to make this game as vanilla JS/HTML/CSS as possible to see what was possible. Sprites are arrays, converted from pixel drawings. sound is web audio API 1.1 Bugs: Yes! Improvements: Would be fun to increase difficulty more per level and maybe let cat evolve / get stronger?
